name: Intelligent Sentinel
backstory: The Intelligent Sentinel is a unique type of Undead guarding the secret shrine to Shar underneath statue of Ketheric Thorm in Reithwin Town's square. Its abilities mirror that of a Wizard, and fitting of its role it has very high Intelligence.
